question: I own one of the new plots in Kumla-Stensta, Vallentuna. Can I build a single-storey house with a 200 m2 footprint, plus a 40 m2 garage?
key_points: The Kumla-Stensta detaljplan limits the building area (byggnadsarea) per property to 180 m2 in the northern part and 160 m2 in the southern part, so a 200 m2 footprint exceeds it
A separate ancillary building (komplementbyggnad) of up to 60 m2 is allowed, so the 40 m2 garage fits
A new house requires a bygglov (PBL 9 kap. 3 §)
There is no municipal water and sewage: a shared well / wastewater solution is needed

question: We are a developer looking at the Mörby backe site (Teknikvägen / Mörbyvägen) in central Vallentuna. Could we build a five-storey apartment block with about 8,000 m2 of gross floor area?
key_points: The detaljplan for Vallentuna-Mörby (Mörby backe) allows about 7,000 m2 BTA (7,700 m2 in the consultation version), less than 8,000 m2
The northern building is limited to four storeys plus an attic storey (vindsvåning); five full storeys are not allowed
Homes must keep a 15 m safety distance from Teknikvägen, a secondary route for dangerous goods
A bigger project would require changing the detaljplan (planbesked)

question: Is it possible to build terraced houses (radhus) in the new Kristineberg district in Vallentuna, and how big can they be?
key_points: The Kristineberg etapp 1 detaljplan provides for about 90-95 terraced houses and 40-45 detached houses
They may have two storeys with a building area of 120-140 m2
Plot sizes are about 250-600 m2
A bygglov is still required for each building

question: My house is inside a detaljplan area in Vallentuna. Can I build a 25 m2 guest cottage (attefallshus) in the garden without a building permit?
key_points: No bygglov is needed for a komplementbostadshus of at most 30 m2 building area and 4 m ridge height, placed on the plot, with at most 45 m2 of such buildings in total (PBL 9 kap. 4 §)
A notification (anmälan) and a start decision (startbesked) from the kommun are still required before building
A bygglov is always required if the property is in a culturally valuable area
Placement close to the property boundary may need the neighbours' consent
source: PBL 9 kap. 4 §; Vallentuna page 'Nybyggnad av komplementbyggnad'

question: We want to build a holiday house about 40 metres from a lake shore in Ydre, outside any zoning plan. Is that possible?
key_points: Shoreline protection (strandskydd) covers 100 m from the shoreline (MB 7 kap. 14 §)
New buildings are prohibited in the strandskydd area (MB 7 kap. 15 §)
It is only possible with a strandskyddsdispens from the kommun, which requires special reasons (särskilda skäl, MB 7 kap. 18 c §)
A bygglov is also needed (and a förhandsbesked can be requested outside detaljplan)

question: We plan an eco-village with 20 houses, shared gardens and a shared sewage treatment plant on farmland we would buy outside Vallentuna town. What would it take?
key_points: A new group of 20 houses needs a detaljplan (PBL 4 kap. 2 §): the first step is a planbesked request to the kommun
Productive farmland (brukningsvärd jordbruksmark) may only be built on to satisfy essential public interests with no reasonable alternative (MB 3 kap. 4 §)
A shared sewage plant needs a permit (FMH 13 §) and can be organised as a gemensamhetsanläggning (anläggningslag)
The kommun's översiktsplan intentions for rural development and the area must be checked
source: PBL, MB, FMH, anläggningslag; Vallentuna planbesked page

question: I'm building a house in the countryside in Uppsala municipality with no municipal sewer. What do I need for the sewage system, and what does it cost?
key_points: A permit (tillstånd) is required to install a sewage system with a WC (FMH 13 §)
The application goes to Uppsala kommun, and you must wait for the written decision before building
Fees: e.g. a fixed fee of 11 744 kr for a standard installation (8 hours), hourly rate 1 468 kr in 2026
The application needs a site plan and information about the soil / installation
source: FMH 13 §; Uppsala page 'Enskilt avlopp – söka tillstånd eller anmäla'

question: I own a large plot in Vallentuna and want to split off part of it to sell as a building plot. How does that work?
key_points: A new property is created by avstyckning in a lantmäteriförrättning (FBL 10 kap. 1 §)
The new property must be lastingly suitable for its purpose (FBL 3 kap. 1 §)
Outside a detaljplan, building on the new plot needs a bygglov / förhandsbesked assessment
The application goes to Lantmäteriet (the kommun informs about the process)

question: We own farmland near Norrtälje and want it rezoned for about 30 homes. What is the process and how long might it take?
key_points: The first step is a written planbesked request; the kommun charges a fee per its taxa, even for a negative answer
The kommun must give its planbesked within four months (PBL 5 kap. 4 §)
Norrtälje prioritises plan work with a planprioriteringsverktyg, and many approved planbesked are waiting, so planning can take years
A detaljplan process follows (samråd, granskning, antagande), and farmland protection applies

question: Can I tear down an old barn on my farm in Ydre? The farm is not in a zoning plan area.
key_points: A rivningslov is required inside detaljplan areas (PBL 9 kap. 43 §); outside them it is only required where områdesbestämmelser say so (PBL 9 kap. 44 §)
So normally no rivningslov is needed for the barn, but the kommun can confirm
Check heritage / cultural value and handle the demolition waste properly

question: Can I convert my holiday cottage in a fritidshusområde in Norrtälje into my permanent home?
key_points: Norrtälje's översiktsplan addresses holiday-home areas and the conversion of holiday homes into permanent homes
Water and sewage capacity is the main issue: permanent living drives expansion of municipal VA; an individual sewage system must meet the requirements
The detaljplan for the area may limit building size, and extensions need permits

question: Could we build a 30 m high lookout tower on open land outside the built-up area in Vallentuna?
key_points: Objects higher than 20 m outside built-up areas (sammanhållen bebyggelse) require consultation with the Swedish Armed Forces (Försvarsmakten)
A bygglov is required
Landscape, riksintressen and the översiktsplan must be checked

question: I'm thinking of buying a field plot outside a village near Uppsala to build a house. Can I find out beforehand whether I'd be allowed to build?
key_points: Yes: apply for a förhandsbesked (PBL 9 kap. 41 §), which settles whether the house can be located there
A positive förhandsbesked is binding if the bygglov is applied for within two years
Uppsala handles förhandsbesked with fees and an assessment of location, farmland, VA and access

question: I want to build a house on Gotland with my own well and septic system. What does Region Gotland require for water and sewage in the building permit case?
key_points: Documents about the water and sewage solution must be submitted in the bygglov case; the process differs for own (enskilt) VA and connection to the municipal network
An individual sewage system with WC needs a permit (FMH 13 §)
The översiktsplan gives guidance on VA conditions in each area
source: Region Gotland page 'Vatten och avlopp i bygglovsärenden'; FMH 13 §
